# Theme fixtures

`tokyo-night`, `nord`, `catppuccin` (Catppuccin Mocha), `catppuccin-latte` and `vantablack` are
unchanged copies of `colors.toml` from Omarchy's stock themes in `/usr/share/omarchy/themes`,
taken on 2026-10-22 from the `omarchy` package 4.0.6-1 (its `version` file says 4.0.0.alpha).
Upstream: <https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy/tree/master/themes>. Do not edit them; replace
them with newer copies when Omarchy changes its themes, and say so in `docs/checks.md`.

`custom-incomplete` and `custom-malformed` were written by hand for ODK's tests and are not
Omarchy themes.
